62302.name: Dominator Drive · First Strike
62302.SpecificEffects:
ST movement type changes to Levitating, enabling it to pass over low obstacles.
When initiating combat, if the target is on the movement path, will always Dodge when retaliated against. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
When actively attacking for the <color=#F74848>1st</color> time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
